description: This PHP class 'OAuthCodeGrantManager' manages OAuth2 authorization request sessions, including saving, loading, validating, and cleaning up session data related to OAuth2 authorization flows within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: OAuthCodeGrantManager
classes.description: Manages OAuth2 authorization code grant flow sessions, including saving request data to session, loading authorization requests, session cleanup, and validation of confirmation requests.

methods.name: saveRequestToSession
methods.description: Stores OAuth2 authorization request parameters into PHP session variables.

methods.name: loadAuthorizationRequest
methods.description: Loads and validates OAuth2 authorization request data from session, reconstructs the authorization request object, and associates the current user.

methods.name: cleanupSession
methods.description: Removes OAuth2 authorization request data from session variables.

methods.name: validateConfirmationRequest
methods.description: Validates the OAuth2 confirmation request by checking session data and request parameters for consistency and authenticity.

methods.name: getQueryParam
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve a specific query parameter from the request.
